# OpenAI Python SDK License Provenance & Compliance Evidence

Project: OpenAI Python SDK
Component Family: OpenAI API Client
Verified License Identifier: Apache-2.0 (Apache License, Version 2.0)
Verification Date: 2026-10-02
Compliance Disposition: ACCEPTABLE (Permissive open source; approved for Phase-2 Task Intelligence adoption)

## Verified Upstream Source

1. OpenAI Python Client Library
   - Package Name: openai
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/openai/openai-python
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-2 Role: Wire protocol and HTTP transport client consumed by PydanticAI's `OpenAIProvider`. Enables hosted model communication with any standard OpenAI-compatible API gateway (e.g. Sarvam AI, vLLM, hosted inference endpoints) without vendor lock-in.

## Direct Dependency Necessity Rationale
- PydanticAI's official `OpenAIProvider` dynamically instantiates `openai.AsyncOpenAI` for streaming and completions.
- Declared directly in `pyproject.toml` per repository convention for explicit dependency tracking and reproducible build locking.
- Not used for proprietary OpenAI lock-in; configured with neutral `base_url` pointing to authorized hosted gateways.

## Architectural Boundaries & Isolation
- Consumed strictly as an in-process library dependency behind PydanticAI model abstractions.
- Never directly called from domain or business logic; all interactions flow through `get_llm_model` and `PydanticAiPlanner`.
- Zero credentials committed; API keys resolved strictly via `SecretStr` from environment variables.

## Attribution & Usage Policy
- Import and consume unmodified binary wheels as versioned package dependencies.
- Retain standard Apache-2.0 copyright and NOTICE files in external release distribution manifests.
- Zero copying of upstream source code into IR application core.
